messages:
incident-bot: Pager [P1] — latency spike on inference-hosted-eu (eu-west-1). p95 ~1200ms, error-rate 2.4%. Links: https://infra.redwood/incident/1769994322 · runbook: /runbooks/inference-latency · @oncall-primary Maya Gupta, @oncall-secondary Jon Park
Maya Gupta: I'm the primary but I leave for travel in ~40m. I'll stay on until handover, but if this escalates someone please pick up primary. :airplane:
Jon Park: I can take primary if needed. Shadowing now. What's the immediate mitigation plan?
Priya Nair: Looking at graphs — there's a big spike in cache eviction ops around the same time. Any deploys or config changes in the last hour?
Tomas Eriksson: No prod deploys in the last 2h. Autoscaler did a couple of scale-ups then down — looks flappy. I can try bumping dedicated pool capacity as quick mitigation.
Maya Gupta: Runbook quick steps: 1) confirm worker OOMs/log spikes; 2) check KV cache thrash; 3) enable fallback-route if latency doesn't recover. Quick commands:
```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-worker --since=15m | grep -i "evict\|oom"
curl -s https://metrics.redwood/dash/cache-eu | jq '.evictions_last_5m'
```
Jon Park: Running those now. Also will enable routing fallback to model-xs to reduce per-request cost/latency while we stabilize:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/internal/route/fallback -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","target":"model-xs"}'
```
incident-bot: Action logged: fallback-route enabled by Jon Park at 1769994380. Customers in EU may see lower-quality outputs; no 503s reported yet. :warning:
Priya Nair: Customer-impact update: two mid-market ecom customers reported higher latency in the last 10m; no open escalations yet. If we keep p95 >800ms we'll notify them formally.
Tomas Eriksson: I've kicked a quick scale job to add +2 GPUs to the dedicated inference-eu pool. Command: `./bin/allocate --pool inference-eu --count 2`. ETA ~6m to spin up.
Jon Park: After enabling fallback + initial scale the p95 dropped from ~1200ms -> ~420ms and errors from 2.4% -> 0.2%. Continuing to monitor. I'll remain primary until handoff completed.
Maya Gupta: Thanks — I'm going to record handoff in the rota: Maya -> Jon at 1769994600. Support, please hold customer communications until we confirm stable. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Notified support queue about degraded quality and that a mitigation notice will be sent to affected customers if degradation persists beyond 15m.
Tomas Eriksson: Followup runbook pointer (if it flaps again): disable KV cache for hot prefixes and restart workers one at a time to avoid thundering herd: set `REDWOOD_CACHE_ENABLED=false` on worker config and `kubectl rollout restart` on the worker daemonset. See runbook section 4.
Jon Park: If this spikes back during Maya's travel window, Priya can you be backup for the APAC overlap? I'll be in APAC starting tomorrow but can remote.
Priya Nair: Yep I can be the secondary for APAC nights. I'll also draft a short canned message for support to use if we need to notify customers.
Maya Gupta: Handing off now — primary -> Jon Park at 1769994600. Leaving the thread and my phone on for one hour. Thanks everyone. :wave:
incident-bot: Thread marked as active mitigation. Please update the incident ticket if any rollback or config change is performed.
